[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 12:24  
[EVENT] User is thinking of cleaning their jewelry collection this weekend.  
[EVENT] User got a new pair of emerald earrings last weekend at a flea market.  
[PREFERENCE] User is absolutely loving their new emerald earrings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your new emerald earrings!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cleaning your jewelry collection can be a daunting task, but with the right techniques and materials, you can keep your pieces looking their best.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for cleaning jewelry include: handle with care, avoid harsh chemicals, use a soft cloth, and dry thoroughly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific cleaning methods for gold and silver jewelry: mix a solution of warm water and mild soap, soak for 15-30 minutes, scrub with a soft-bristled toothbrush, rinse with warm water, and dry with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific cleaning methods for pearls: gently wipe with a soft, damp cloth, avoid soap or harsh chemicals, and dry flat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific cleaning methods for diamonds and gemstones: mix a solution of warm water and mild soap, soak for 15-30 minutes, scrub with a soft-bristled toothbrush, rinse with warm water, and dry with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For emeralds, use a slightly more gentle approach, as they can be prone to scratching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific cleaning methods for tarnished silver jewelry: use a silver polishing cloth or a solution of baking soda and water, apply to tarnished area, let sit for 15-30 minutes, rinse with warm water, and dry with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific cleaning methods for costume jewelry: gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth and avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include using ultrasonic cleaners with caution, reading instructions for commercial cleaning solutions, and considering professional cleaning for specialized care.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should clean their jewelry regularly to prevent dirt and oils from building up.  
[EVENT] User wants to make sure they are taking good care of their new emerald earrings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for storing emerald earrings include: store them separately in soft, padded pouches, use a high-quality jewelry box or case, consider a jewelry armoire for larger collections, keep them away from direct sunlight, avoid humid environments, and check on them regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should avoid storing emerald earrings in a pile to prevent scratching or damage.
